# ExecutionOutcome

How a run an automation started ended.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Pending"` | The run is still going. |
| `"Success"` | The run finished. |
| `"Failed"` | The run ended in error, or could not be started. |
| `"Killed"` | The run was stopped by someone. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`ExecutionHistoryEntry`](execution-history-entry.md)
